messages.text: Got it, you're after a floor-standing globe rather than the desktop Adams. Since National Geographic is the style you're drawn to, the Replogle Kingsley 16" Floor Globe gives you that same National Geographic design but illuminated and sized for the floor — a real centerpiece for a room. You'll find it under "Replogle Kingsley 16" Floor Globe - Illuminated National Geographic Design" in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
